constituentSelection: fixed 2026-10-13 SOX members retroactively; not point-in-time membership
coveragePolicy: observed-only breadth, denominator and missing symbols retained

definitions.recovering: breadthChange3Pp >= 20 and breadthChange1Pp > 0 and breadth three sessions earlier <= 40

limitations: Fixed-current membership introduces survivorship and look-ahead selection bias; descriptive research only, not point-in-time predictive validation.
Overlapping forward horizons inflate apparent sample sizes; do not interpret as independent observations.
Signal thresholds are exploratory and not tuned or validated.
Observed-only breadth uses 29 stocks before Q history becomes available; coverage must be considered.
Missing forward labels remain null; no synthetic prices or outcomes.
